home.js.why: The home page's JavaScript, gzip: the showcase must stay fast. main before the showcase measured 238.7. Raised with the Kirana site's header and footer (the footer's landscape loads its drawing on demand) (Base UI's NavigationMenu and the mega menu, about 13 KB on every page; its panels load on demand). Then to 295 KB with the four project pages: the router's route tree, which every page loads, grows with each page the site adds. Then to 302 KB with the showcase's framework switch (Base UI's Tabs, about 6 KB; the other frameworks' showcases load in their frame, not in this page). Then for the typeset builder (P3-13): its two routes in the route tree every page loads, and the header's Typeset link, about 2.4 KB; main measured 302.5 before it, already over by the per-framework docs' page manifest (#46).

home.css.why: The stylesheets the home page loads, gzip: Kirana's compiled stylesheet and the registry's reset and fonts. Then to 52 KB for the fonts (CLI-11): every family of the font axes now has its token entries on `<html>` (the body's and the heading's, about 1 KB), where only Inter and Geist had.
